fact: Graduates in science, technology, engineering and mathematics were 12 per cent of tertiary graduates in Angola in 2015, by UNESCO's series.
Economia & Mercado, from the MESCTI Anuario Estatistico, reports about 11% of Angola's 29,302 tertiary graduates in 2022/23 were in science, technology, engineering and mathematics (under 3,200).
The MESCTI yearbook says 3,076 (9.8%) of the 31,503 graduates of academic year 2022-2023 were in STEM.
